scope: Independent command hooks for a bounded interactive client startup observation
constraints: Standard library only; no previous implementation, dependency fixture or client source input
No stdin, transcript, credential-store or external endpoint reads
Exactly two authenticated loopback POSTs to fixed test routes, one private exclusive PID record and one synthetic JSON systemMessage
An eight-second whole HTTP deadline and a twelve-second main deadline bound blocking IO
No proxy, redirect, retry, model request, client tool, additional context or initial user message
The parent holds one request to distinguish hook arrival, hook return and visible terminal output; no general readiness guarantee is inferred
